name: @meowshed/meow-prose-gate
description: Stops Claude Code from publishing a commit message, pull request, issue, comment or release note that carries a writing defect any reader can point to. A program blocks a stock idiom from a fixed list, a line of bold text in place of a heading and text hidden in a file, and a model judging twice blocks other idioms, unexpanded acronyms and a bold phrase opening a paragraph only where both judgements agree on a span the text holds. It keeps nothing in context. Distributed as a Pi package.
